method: Generated snapshots with cadgen step snapshot, then opened each PNG with view_image; PDF rendered with Poppler and the complete page visually reviewed

snapshots.review: Four holes, rounded corners, complete plate silhouette visible
Longer plate and expanded hole pattern visible
Four separate pins aligned with the four holes
Open cavity, floor, four bosses and both five-slot vent patterns visible
Independent rounded rectangular lid with four holes visible
Lid placed above the base; side vents and lid/base separation visible

drawing.review: A3 landscape; top/front/right/isometric views, dimensions, hole callout, corner radius, notes and title block legible without clipping or overlapping text

limits: Snapshots are visual evidence; exact dimensions, topology and clearances are established by independent saved STEP checks. Structural performance, production tolerances and physical printability were not evaluated.
